title: Private envelope approval record (aiworks-envelope-approval/1)
description: The owner's approval of one exact campaign declaration (docs/design/WORK_ENVELOPE.md section 5, slice E7). It binds the declaration's authorityDigest and is private installation data: it lives in the installation's data directory or another private location, never in a source branch or pull request. This schema checks the shape only; src/supervisor/approvals.mjs compares the digest, the campaign and revocation.
